property_summary: For any inputs, C always calls the callee with the selector transferFrom(address,address,uint256) (so a recorder observing called selector will see that exact selector for each call) — the mutant sometimes calls the different selector transfer(address,address,uint256), which a recorder can detect by recording the decoded arguments only when the correct selector is used, causing a mismatch for some fuzzed inputs.
change_summary: Change the keccak256 selector from transferFrom(address,address,uint256) to transfer(address,address,uint256) so the called selector differs, which can change return behavior when callee handles selectors differently.
